qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed imaging base and patient monitoring contracts, but catastrophic Respironics foam recall, FDA/DOJ consent decree halting US sleep device production, massive multi-billion-dollar legal liabilities, and market share losses to ResMed, Siemens, and GE have shattered pricing power and depressed ROIC below hurdles.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Proof of Moat & Pricing Power, REJECT). The catastrophic Respironics recall and 2024 DOJ/FDA consent decree eliminated US sleep device sales, inflicted over $2.5B in legal settlements, and permanently ceded market share to ResMed. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC is deeply sub-hurdle (<6%) amid fierce imaging competition from Siemens and GE.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year GAAP ROIC severely depressed by multi-billion-dollar recall provisions, litigation payouts ($1.08B personal injury, $500M economic loss, €288M DOJ settlement), and goodwill write-downs. High-margin sleep and respiratory revenue was largely halted in the US under federal court order, while medical imaging equipment faces fierce tender discounting against Siemens Healthineers and GE HealthCare.
